test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**most easily**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**most easily**" indicates the highest degree of being easy, **which suits the context of conversation being an art that is achievable with minimal effort.**
 
• The other options: "**most occasionally**", "**more easily**", and "**more likely**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Conversation is indeed the most easily__ teachable of all arts.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Most occasionally:** This suggests infrequency, which doesn't fit the context of the teachability of conversation as an art.
 
• **More easily:** This implies a comparison but doesn't convey the superlative sense needed in this context.
 
• **More likely:** This implies probability, which doesn't suit the context of how teachable an art is.
